adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts, line 100 shows `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then line 101-103 shows `await prisma.credential.update({ where: { id: credential.id }, data: { key }, });`. The `parseRefreshTokenResponse` function (shown in the diff at packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts) returns the result of `schema.safeParse(response)` which is an object like `{ success: true, data: {...} }`. This entire object is being stored as `key` in the database, but the code at line 79 expects `googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key)` to work on the raw credential data, not a wrapped safeParse result. This is a real bug - the stored shape will be `{ success: true, data: { access_token, ... } }` instead of just `{ access_token, ... }`.
